hooks.name: Autonomous Task Executor
hooks.description: CI/CD safety check reminder. Fires when user message suggests code changes are about to be pushed.

action.prompt: CI/CD SAFETY: Check status before pushing: `node scripts/check-cicd-status.js`. If IN_PROGRESS or QUEUED — STOP and wait 2 min. Push only via `node scripts/safe-commit-push.js "type: description"`. Never push while a deployment is running (CloudFormation parallel deploys fail).
